explain: 正確答案需 'adj. enough' 修飾 'car'。誘答 'fastly enough' 錯誤（副詞無 fastly），'enough fast' 錯置。考 'S + V + adj. enough to V'。

stem: He is strong enough ____ the heavy box.
explain: 正確答案需 'to V' 表目的。誤選 'lift' 因忽略 'enough to V' 固定結構。考 'enough to V' 的不定詞形式。

translation: 這位學生的體力足夠跑完馬拉松。
reference: The student is strong enough to run the marathon.
comment: 考 'S + V + adj. enough to V'，'strong' 修飾 'student'，'to run' 表目的。需注意形容詞位置。

translation: 她跑得夠快，可以追上公車。
reference: She ran quickly enough to catch the bus.
comment: 考 'V + adv. enough to V'，'quickly' 修飾 'ran'，'to catch' 表目的。需區分副詞與形容詞。

stem: It is ____ for the students to understand the complex theory.
explain: 考點：possible 搭配 it 作形式主詞。選項 (b)(c)(d) 用副詞或形容詞誤用，正確應為 it is possible that... 或 for + 名詞 to V。常見誤選 (a) 但忽略 it 作形式主詞的必要性。

stem: It is possible ____ that he will arrive late.
explain: 考點：S + be possible to V 的正確結構。選項 (a)(c)(d) 用介詞或主詞誤用。常見誤選 (a) 因混淆 for + 名詞 to V 的結構。

stem: ____ is possible for the team to win the championship.
explain: 考點：it 作形式主詞的固定用法。選項 (b)(c)(d) 未符合 it is possible... 的句型，會造成語意錯誤。常見誤選 (b) 因誤以為 that 引導主詞子句。

stem: It is possible that he may be right, but it is ____ for him to be wrong.
explain: 考點：probable/likely 與 possible 的搭配差異。probable/likely 應搭配 it is probable/likely that...，不能直接用 to V。選項 (a) 錯誤，(b)(c) 用法不當。常見誤選 (b)(c) 因混淆搭配方式。

translation: 他可能在下午到達。
reference: It is possible for him to arrive in the afternoon.
explain: 考點：用 it is possible for + 名詞 to V 表達『可能』。避免使用 he may arrive，符合題型要求。
comment: 考點：用 it is possible for + 名詞 to V 表達『可能』。避免使用 he may arrive，符合題型要求。

translation: 他可能贏得比賽。
reference: It is possible for him to win the match.
explain: 考點：用 it is possible for + 名詞 to V 替代 he may win。注意避免用 it is possible that he will win，因題型要求用 S + be possible to V 的結構。
comment: 考點：用 it is possible for + 名詞 to V 替代 he may win。注意避免用 it is possible that he will win，因題型要求用 S + be possible to V 的結構。

stem: The teacher ______ the students as ______.
options: regard, a group of hardworking individuals
regarded, a group of hardworking individuals
explain: 正確答案為A。regard A as B需主詞+動詞原形，且as後接名詞短語。B選項動詞誤用第三人稱單數，C為過去式，D為動名詞不可接as。常見誤選B因忽略主詞單複數。

stem: She was ______ to be a talented musician by her peers.
explain: 正確答案為A。被動語態中，consider後可直接接B，不需to be。B、C、D皆為主動態或錯誤形式。常見誤選C因混淆主動被動結構。

stem: The media ______ the new policy ______ a significant step forward.
explain: 正確答案為A。refer to A as B需動詞原形，主詞為media（複數）用regard/ refer。B選項動詞誤用單數，C為過去式，D為動名詞。常見誤選B因忽略media為複數。

stem: They ______ the project ______ a failure, but it turned out to be a success.
explain: 正確答案為C。deem A B可直接接名詞，不需to be。A、B、D需to be或錯誤形式。常見誤選A因誤用considered as，正確應為considered a。

translation: 他被視為一位傑出的科學家。
reference: He was regarded as an outstanding scientist.
comment: 正確使用被動語態regard A as B。注意as後接名詞短語，不可省略a/an。常見錯誤是直接寫regarded a scientist。

translation: 我們認為這是一個錯誤的決定。
reference: We consider this a wrong decision.
comment: consider A B結構，B為名詞短語。避免使用to be，符合英語習慣。常見錯誤是寫成consider this to be a wrong decision。

stem: ____ the weather is today!
explain: 正確選項為How，因How後接形容詞beautiful，且weather為不可數名詞，不可用What。常見誤選What是混淆了What + adj. + noun的結構。

stem: ____ important the meeting is!
explain: 正確選項為How，因How後接形容詞important，且meeting為單數名詞，不需冠詞。常見誤選What是誤用What + adj. + noun結構，但此處無名詞。

stem: ____ matters most is your effort, not the result.
explain: 正確選項為What，因What引導名詞子句作主詞，且matters是動詞。常見誤選How是誤將感嘆句當作主詞結構。

stem: ____ difficult the task is, we must complete it on time.
explain: 正確選項為How，因How後接形容詞difficult，且task為單數名詞，不需冠詞。常見誤選What是混淆了What + adj. + noun的結構，但此處無名詞。

translation: 多麼重要的決定啊！
reference: How important the decision is!
comment: 此題考How + adj. + S + be/V結構，注意決定為單數名詞，不可加a。常見錯誤是寫成What important the decision is。

translation: 什麼是最重要的？努力，而不是結果。
reference: What matters most is your effort, not the result.
comment: 此題考What + S + be/V名詞子句作主詞，注意matters是動詞，且主詞一致。常見錯誤是誤用How。

stem: It was difficult ______ Lisa to wake up early after staying up late last night.
explain: It was difficult for sb to V：for + 人表示「對某人而言很困難」的客觀情況；of 用於描述人的行為品格（如 kind of him），此處不通。

stem: It is impossible ______ Paris without its Eiffel Tower.
explain: It is + adj + to V：不定詞才是真正的主詞；空格前已有 impossible，後接 to V 完整結構。

stem: In Japan, it is acceptable ______ slurping sounds when eating soup.
explain: acceptable for sb to V：「對某人來說可接受」用 for + 人 + to V；that 子句內需有完整動詞，B、D 結構錯誤。

stem: It is useless ______ a secret if everyone already knows.
explain: It is useless + to V（虛主詞句型）；本課與 of no use + V-ing 作對比，此句考 to V。helps 詞性不合。

stem: It is of no use ______ with someone who won't listen.
explain: It is of no use + V-ing：of no use 後接動名詞；argued 為過去分詞、to argue 不符此句型。

stem: There is no use ______ about this matter.
explain: There is no use + V-ing：與 of no use 同型，後接動名詞。

stem: It is ______ time for the guests ______ home before it gets late.
explain: It is high time for sb to V：high time 後接 for + 人 + to V；A 的 that 子句動詞需用過去式，go 不符。

stem: It is time that the children ______ away their toys and ______ to bed.
explain: It is time that + 過去式（擬語氣）：put 與 went 都要用過去式，兩動詞一致。

stem: Last autumn, when nights got too cold to sleep in the park, Snoopy realized it was time that he ______ arrangements for his annual winter log.
explain: it was time that + 過去式：敘述過去，用 made。

stem: It is time that the overweight man ______ down on his consumption of fat and sugar.
explain: cut down on 為固定片語（減少攝取）；time that + 過去式 cut（cut 原形＝過去式同形）。

stem: ______ occurred to Anna that she might have left her keys in the car.
explain: It occurred to sb that...：「某人突然想到」，It 為虛主詞，That/Ideas/Thought 無法構成此句型。

stem: ______ David that he had misplaced an important document.
explain: It struck sb that...：某人靈光一現；It occurred 需接 to sb（C 缺 to），B 語意為「發生」不合。

stem: An idea ______ me when I was looking at the sky.
explain: Sth struck sb：某念頭襲上心頭；occur 需用 occur to sb，B 缺 to。

stem: Rapid advancement in motor engineering makes ______ technically possible to build a flying car in the near future.
explain: make it + adj + to V：it 為形式受詞，真正受詞是後面的 to V。

stem: What made it ______ to build a road through the Glacier National Park?
explain: make it + adj：空格填形容詞作 OC；其餘選項多餘動詞破壞結構。

stem: It is the Sun ______ supports the kingdoms of the recording companies.
explain: 強調句型 It is + 強調主詞 + that...：無介系詞、非人物外一律用 that。

stem: It is ______ the beautiful landscape that drew tourists here.
explain: 強調句型 It is + 強調部分 + that：只有 A 能作語氣副詞插入強調結構，其餘會與 It is 重複衝突。

stem: _____ knowing when the continuous rain will stop.
explain: There is no + V-ing：「沒辦法知道」；It's no 需接名詞或改 It is no use。

stem: _____ predicting which team this famous basketball player will join.
options: It is out of the question
explain: There is no + V-ing：「無法預測」；There is not 為錯誤結構（需 there is not + any）。

stem: _____ that laughter is the best medicine.
options: It is out of the question of denying
There is no possibility to explain
explain: There is no arguing that...：「不容爭辯」；其餘選項片語或接法錯誤。

stem: It is sunny today. There are several kids _____ bicycles in the park.
explain: There are + N + V-ing：孩子們「正在騎」車，用進行式分詞。

stem: There will be a special meal _____ tonight to celebrate my sister's 20th birthday.
explain: There will be + N + p.p.：餐點是「被準備好的」，用過去分詞被動修飾。

stem: On Dragon Boat Festival, there are many activities _____ to celebrate this day.
explain: There are + N + p.p.：活動「被舉辦」用 held；occur/happen 不用被動、take place 無被動。

stem: It is crucial _____ students to practice writing essays regularly to improve their skills.
explain: It is + adj + for sb to V：對學生而言重要用 for；of 用於人的行為。

stem: It is of no use _____ the same excuse repeatedly; Mother won't believe it.
explain: It is of no use + V-ing：後接動名詞。

stem: It is high time that everyone _____ action to address climate change.
explain: It is high time that + 過去式：擬語氣用 took。

stem: Most teachers consider _____ necessary for students to submit their assignments in time.
explain: consider it + adj + to V：it 為形式受詞，代替後方 to V。

stem: It is the leading actor's performance _____ makes the movie so unforgettable.
explain: 強調句型 It is + 強調主詞 + that：強調「主演的表現」用 that。

translation: 傳播有關他人的謠言是不道德的。
reference: It is immoral to spread rumors about other people on the Internet.
comment: It is + adj + to V（虛主詞）；避免寫成 It is immoral of people...（of 用於人的品格）。

translation: 對大多數外國人來說，學習如何寫中文是困難的。
reference: It is difficult for most foreigners to learn how to write Chinese characters.
comment: It is + adj + for sb + to V：for 表客觀情況。

translation: 表現不同文化對大多數人來說是被接受的。
reference: It is acceptable for the majority of people to express different cultures.
comment: It is + adj + for sb + to V；majority of + 可數複數。

translation: 對這位年輕男孩來說，關心他人的感受是重要的。
reference: It is important for the young boy to care about other people's feelings.
comment: It is + adj + for sb + to V。

translation: 如果你沒有為工作面試做好準備，當遇到困難時陷入自怨自哀是沒有用的。
reference: It is of no use indulging in self-pity when we face difficulties if you don't prepare yourself for the job interview.
comment: It is of no use + V-ing：of no use 後接動名詞。

translation: 對於發生的這件事，後悔是沒有用的。
reference: There is no use regretting that the event already happened.
comment: There is no use + V-ing。

translation: 當該是 Whitney 上大學的時候，她有點緊張。
reference: When it was time to go to college, Whitney was a bit nervous.
comment: It is/was time (for sb) to V。

translation: 該是老師做決定的時候了。
reference: It is time for the teacher to make the decision.
comment: It is time for sb to V。

translation: 該是學生們學習沒有我的協助如何生活的時候了。
reference: It is high time that students learned how to live without my help.
comment: It is high time that + 過去式（擬語氣）。

translation: 該是瑪麗亞上台演出的時候了。
reference: It is time for Maria to take the stage and perform.
comment: It is time for sb to V。

translation: 莉莎突然想到她必須聯絡她童年的玩伴。
reference: It occurred to Lisa that she had to contact her childhood playmate.
comment: It occurred to sb that...：某人突然想到。

translation: 莉莎今天排定的預約好像改期了。
reference: It occurred to her that her appointment for today had been rescheduled.
comment: It occurred to sb that...；被動語態 rescheduled。

translation: 坎寧安（Cunningham）突然想到他必須支付昂貴的學費。
reference: It occurred to Cunningham that he had to pay the expensive tuition.
comment: It occurred to sb that...。

translation: 他突然想到他可能誤解了指示。
reference: It occurred to him that he may have misunderstood the instructions.
comment: It occurred to sb that...＋ might have p.p.。

translation: 我突然想到他在下公車前忘了鎖門。
reference: It occurred to me that he had forgotten to lock the door before he got off the bus.
comment: It occurred to sb that...；下公車＝get off the bus。

translation: 史奈德（Snyder）想到他可以改變他提問的方式。
reference: It struck Snyder that he could change the way he framed the question.
comment: It strikes sb that...：某人靈光一現。

translation: 快時尚具有速度快、成本低的特點，這使得人們可以買到時尚且負擔得起的衣服。
reference: Fast fashion features speed and low cost, which makes it possible for people to buy fashionable clothing at affordable prices.
comment: make it possible for sb to V：it 為形式受詞。

translation: 這個過程讓他們有機會出國留學或參加國際體育賽事。
reference: The process gives them an opportunity to study abroad or attend international sports events.
comment: give sb an opportunity to V。

translation: 老師認為挑戰她的學生去理解主要內容是很重要的。
reference: The teacher finds it important for students to understand the main idea.
comment: find it + adj + for sb + to V：it 為形式受詞。

translation: 這家公司認為提供員工教育訓練是有幫助的。
reference: This company thinks it helpful for employees to attend training.
comment: think it + adj + for sb + to V。

translation: 詹姆士（James）這個星期日要和丹妮爾（Danielle）去吃高級餐廳。（強調主詞）
reference: It is James that will have dinner with Danielle in a high-end restaurant this Sunday.
comment: 強調主詞：It is + 主詞 + that...。

translation: 詹姆士這個星期日要和丹妮爾去吃高級餐廳。（強調受詞）
reference: It is Danielle that James will have dinner with in a high-end restaurant this Sunday.
comment: 強調受詞：被強調的受詞移到 that 前。

translation: 詹姆士這個星期日要和丹妮爾去吃高級餐廳。（強調地點）
reference: It is in a high-end restaurant that James will have dinner with Danielle this Sunday.
comment: 強調地點：It is + 地點片語 + that...。

translation: 詹姆士這個星期日要和丹妮爾去吃高級餐廳。（強調時間）
reference: It is this Sunday that James will have dinner with Danielle in a high-end restaurant.
comment: 強調時間：It is + 時間 + that...。

translation: 許多雜誌也是因為福爾摩斯（Sherlock Holmes）這部作品而出名。
reference: It was because of Sherlock Holmes that many magazines also became famous.
comment: 強調原因：It was + because of + N + that...。

translation: 這些痛苦的經歷改變了我看待事物的角度。
reference: It was painful experiences that changed my perspective on life.
comment: 強調主詞：It was + 主詞 + that...。

translation: 是蘇菲亞（Sophia）堅定的領導讓我們的團隊團結在一起。
reference: It was Sophia's firm leadership that made our group work together.
comment: 強調主詞：It was + 主詞 + that...。

translation: 珍對工作的奉獻使她相較於同僚脫穎而出。
reference: It is Jane's devotion to her work that makes her stand out from her colleagues.
comment: 強調主詞：It is + 主詞 + that...；stand out from 脫穎而出。

translation: 在競爭激烈的世界，我們必須培養批判性思考的技能。
reference: In a highly competitive world, it is necessary for us to develop critical thinking skills.
comment: It is + adj + for sb + to V。

translation: 與拒絕傾聽的人爭辯是毫無意義的。
reference: There is no use arguing with a person who refuses to listen.
comment: There is no use + V-ing。

translation: 這是孩子們收拾玩具並開始做功課的時候了。
reference: It is time for the children to put away their toys and start their homework.
comment: It is time for sb to V。

translation: 我同事突然想到他忘了寄電子郵件給客戶。
reference: It struck my colleague that he had forgotten to send the email to the client.
comment: It strikes sb that...。

translation: 大多數的家長都認為孩子們積極參加課外活動很重要。
reference: Most parents think it important for children to take an active part in extracurricular activities.
comment: think it + adj + for sb + to V。

translation: 有無數的機會在等待那些努力工作的人。
reference: There are countless opportunities waiting for those who work hard.
comment: There + be + N + V-ing：正在等待的機會。

translation: 上週五有一個活動慶祝已故的流行歌手麥克傑克森。
reference: There was an event held last Friday in memory of the late pop singer Michael Jackson.
comment: There + be + N + p.p.：活動是「被舉辦」的，held 修飾 event。

translation: 它的網站一次公布 14 位藝人的作品。
reference: There are works of fourteen artists posted at a time on its website.
comment: There + be + N + p.p.：作品是「被刊登」的，用 p.p.。

translation: 許多問題尚未獲得解答，但有三個主要的原因已獲得確認。
reference: There are still a lot of questions unanswered, but three main causes have been identified.
comment: There + be + N + p.p.（unanswered）；後半用完成被動 have been identified。

translation: 在化妝舞會裡，有很多舞者穿著奇怪吸引人注目的服裝。
reference: There are many dancers dressed in strange and eye-catching costumes at the masquerade ball.
comment: There + be + N + p.p.：穿著＝dressed in。

translation: 有很多人在排隊等候音樂會的票。
reference: There are many people waiting in line for concert tickets.
comment: There + be + N + V-ing：正在排隊的人。

translation: 現在有幾個計畫正在由團隊開發。
reference: There are several projects being developed by the group now.
comment: There + be + N + being + p.p.：進行式被動。

translation: 不可否認，科技讓我們的生活更加便利。
reference: There is no denying that technology has made our lives more convenient.
comment: There is no denying that...：不容否認。

translation: 那些受害者看著自己的家園被毀心裡是不容爭辯的事實。
reference: There is no arguing that these victims were sad to see their homes destroyed.
comment: There is no arguing that...：不容爭辯。

translation: 不知道這很有天分的魔術師會呈現什麼魔術給觀眾。
reference: There is no knowing what tricks this talented magician will present to the audience.
comment: There is no knowing + wh- 子句：無從得知。

translation: 如果我們繼續破壞地球，我們無法逃避行為的後果。
reference: If we continue to damage the Earth, there is no escaping the consequences of our actions.
comment: There is no escaping...：無法逃避。

translation: 無法解釋這位支持者突然的態度轉變。
reference: There is no explaining why the supporter suddenly changed their attitude.
comment: There is no explaining why...：無從解釋。

translation: 一旦 Fiona 下定決心，就沒辦法阻止她。
reference: There is no stopping Fiona once she sets her mind to something.
comment: There is no stopping sb：無法阻止某人。
